items.title: Higher direct images commute with filtered colimits of bounded below complexes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma extends the degreewise compatibility of higher direct images with filtered colimits to bounded below complexes of abelian sheaves along the inverse systems of the companion lemma (statement lines 7930-7945). The proof repeats the spectral sequence comparison: the companion degreewise result is applied to the terms (proof lines 7948-7964), the two spectral sequences of a complex under the direct image functor are displayed, and boundedness below provides the index-independent finiteness that makes the first page comparison valid (proof lines 7965-7968), after which the abutments are compared (proof lines 7968-7972). The non-formal content is the same finiteness bookkeeping as in the absolute case. The claim is H2: a spectral sequence comparison whose finiteness input is stated.
